harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RHEL 9.8) and installed its certificate as a trusted system CA via update-ca-trust. Verified trust anchor status before and after a full node reboot (boot_id changed, confirming an actual restart), demonstrating the trust configuration persists.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 9.8) and confirmed openssl/update-ca-trust availability, captured baseline boot_id
Generated a 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed X.509 CA certificate with CN 'OS Comparison Root CA', CA:TRUE basicConstraints, keyCertSign/cRLSign keyUsage, 10-year validity
Copied the CA cert to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and ran update-ca-trust extract
Verified trust anchor status via 'trust list' and successful 'openssl verify' against the system ca-bundle
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline, triggered systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed
Re-verified post-restart that the CA remains a trust anchor and openssl verify still succeeds

evidence.requirement: Local CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created on node1
evidence.summary: Generated CA key and self-signed cert with subject CN=OS Comparison Root CA, CA:TRUE, valid 10 years

evidence.requirement: CA certificate installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Copied cert into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors, ran update-ca-trust extract; 'trust list' shows label 'OS Comparison Root CA' trust: anchor, and openssl verify against system ca-bundle returns OK
Captured baseline boot_id 910dc564-cb62-46fc-8290-c332e63d6201 and confirmed CA trust anchor healthy prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot with 1s delay; exec call returned pid confirmation before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot (connection timed out twice), then reachable again with new boot_id 467edfff-fffd-4b58-9d1d-2b232c01d3d7, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of CA trust configuration
evidence.summary: After reboot, 'trust list' still shows OS Comparison Root CA as anchor, openssl verify still returns OK, and anchor file still present on disk
